title: Winter Concert
description: The Lincoln High School Bands present their annual Winter Concert featuring the Concert Band, Wind Ensemble and Jazz Band. Doors at 6:30 pm.

refundPolicy.text: If the concert is cancelled you receive a full refund of the price you paid. If it is postponed your ticket is valid for the new date, or you may request a full refund.

feeDisclosure.processorNote: The price shown is the price you pay. Card processing is paid by Lincoln High School Bands out of that price.
